review_kind: Codex AI bounded source-only Q3 opacity and shared shape-contract map
scope: Current declared LivePreviewPanel source/mask pixmap-setting branches and selected shared _ZoomView callers/interaction/export dependencies; no whole-library audit.
conclusion: The inspected nonempty normal live source/mask outputs are constructed as RGB888 without an alpha channel. This does not establish that every shared _ZoomView caller is opaque, or authorize blanket BoundingRectShape. FigureQueue deliberately supports alpha-bearing pictures and transparent presentation. No runtime alpha values, speedup or benchmark causation were measured.

facts: numpy_to_qpixmap explicitly drops channels beyond three, fills missing channels, makes contiguous RGB bytes and constructs QImage.Format_RGB888 before QPixmap.fromImage. A fourth source channel is not retained as alpha by this path.
overlay_masks writes RGB boundary pixels into an RGB composite; these live masks are not separate alpha-bearing QGraphicsItems.

The eleven literal source/mask setter calls consist of ten normal converted/aliased image paths and one empty failure pixmap. These are source construction statements, not sampled runtime alpha values.
The separate live comparison canvas also uses numpy_to_qpixmap at5583, but is outside the two source/mask view count.

call_map.construction: RGB888; label zero is black, not transparent
RGB composite then RGB888, not separate translucent scene item
RGB888; missing-map alternative show_message uses text rather than pixmap

call_map.path: Filtering failed with no source -> QPixmap()
call_map.construction: Null/empty pixmap; not a nonempty opaque image claim

call_map.path: Historical no-mask result -> alias of src_pix

normal_live_source_mask_construction.boundary: No proof of arbitrary dynamically supplied/plugin/test pixmaps or invalid inputs; _ZoomView.set_pixmap itself does not inspect or enforce opacity.

shared_alpha_preserving_paths.fact: Shared set_pixmap accepts a QPixmap directly, adds it to a fresh scene and enables DeviceCoordinateCache. It neither converts toRGB nor selects shape mode.

Figure raster writing uses transparent=figure_bg_is_transparent(bg); none/transparent/empty configuration tokens request transparency. This supports transparent output as an intended option, not a claim about actual current figures.

_as_pixmap_image only changes ARGB32 to RGB32 if all alpha bytes are255; otherwise it retains ARGB32_Premultiplied. Other formats are returned unchanged. Actual alpha bytes were not read in this review.
FigureQueue hands decoded/from-file QPixmaps to the same _ZoomView. _display_pixmap returns its fallback without flattening alpha.
Async figure preview constructs QImage.Format_RGBA8888 from canvas.buffer_rgba and wraps it with QPixmap.fromImage for the shared view; no RGB-only conversion is enforced there.
View, viewport and scene background are intentionally transparent, with Qt.NoBrush and autoFillBackground(False). Figure-click and context-menu behavior use this shared view.

SegmentationViews.show_picture accepts an existing QPixmap without conversion, and a caller can supply a _ZoomView-compatible canvas. Array input goes throughRGB, directQPixmap input has no opacity contract. This is an API seam, not a claim that a specific transparent instance currently reaches it.

ruler.fact: Ruler intercepts gestures before inherited handling, maps viewport to image coordinates and explicitly checks pixmap.boundingRect to exclude letterboxing. It paints after super().paintEvent on the viewport, including a translucent badge. It is not a scene overlay item or proof of mask-aware hit behavior.

pan_zoom_hover_click.fact: ScrollHandDrag and inherited mouse handling remain; paired pan mirrors scrollbar values, zoom maps cursor through viewport transforms, hover emits mapped image coordinates, click uses press/release displacement. App-level handlers do not explicitly call pixmap.shape/opaqueArea. That does not establish Qt internal scene hit/occlusion equivalence after shape-mode changes.

export.fact: picture() returns full-resolution item.pixmap, not viewport capture or cache raster. Save pipeline converts that picture toQImage at request time; ruler-right-click guard is separate. Changing shape must not flatten alpha or substitute a scaled cached image as an export shortcut; no such source change was made.

why_blanket_shape_change_not_established.source_gap: No inspected setter has an explicit rectangle-only or opaque-only input contract. Known alpha-preserving FigureQueue paths invalidate a universal opaque-input assumption.
why_blanket_shape_change_not_established.Qt_boundary: BoundingRectShape is a rectangular coverage policy rather than an alpha-mask coverage policy. Transparency-sensitive contains/shape/opaque-area/obscured behavior needs owning Qt validation; this review did not inspect native Qt C++ implementations or execute those methods. It does not assert that a visible regression must occur in the current single-item scene.
why_blanket_shape_change_not_established.API_reference_scope: Static signatures/enums only: QGraphicsPixmapItem exposes MaskShape/BoundingRectShape/HeuristicMaskShape and contains/shape/opaqueArea/isObscuredBy. This is not runtime version verification or behavioral proof.
why_blanket_shape_change_not_established.overlay_qualification: Normal live mask overlays are RGB composites and ruler overlay is viewport drawing, so neither establishes a current translucent scene-layer dependency. Shared transparent pixmaps and inherited scene behavior remain the relevant boundary.

remaining_owner_questions: If Home considers a scoped shape policy, declare its eligibility and preserve transparent shared paths; no policy implementation or safety approval is provided here.
Verify transparent holes/edges, scene hit/contains/opaque-area/culling and background compositing without inferring equivalence from cache mode or RGB benchmark input.
Preserve ruler/letterbox, peer pan/cursor zoom/click/context menus and full-resolution alpha-preserving export across the proposed change.
A mask-shape cost or measurable benefit remains an untested hypothesis; this source map does not explain the Qt2 ratio or permit changing its strict0.75 bound.
uninspected_or_limited: Not a complete dynamic call graph, plugin surface or whole widget-library safety review.
Timelapse source/output and host-pathogen selected render branches were read and use numpy_to_qpixmap; other branches in those modules were not fully audited.
Direct SegmentationViews QPixmap entry was traced; all callers of that public seam were not exhaustively inspected.
No arbitrary loaded PNG, matplotlib buffer or runtime pixel alpha inspected.
Native Qt shape/opaque-area implementation and actual event/culling effects remain unverified.
acceptance: Source-only input for Home Qt owner; no optimization, performance or universal-opacity/safety acceptance.
